personality_one_liner: An authoritative, paper-precise financial accounting system designed with magazine-like clarity for village-owned enterprise (BUMKam) managers.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial vertical spacing with clean card separation and tabular data alignment.

do's: Use clean paper-like surfaces with hairline borders
Maintain high contrast for accounting figures
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs that reduce financial data scannability
Do not use dark or neon corporate SaaS styles

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of BUMKam financial health with key performance indicators and quick transaction feeds.

states.loading: Centered spinning indicator with subtle skeleton cards
states.empty: Illustrated ledger icon with prompt to initialize opening balances
states.error: Banner with readable error message and retry button

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical feed with sticky top header, multi-unit selector pill, 2-column KPI metric cards, cash flow summary chart, and recent transaction list items.

screens.name: Sales (Penjualan)
screens.purpose: Manage customer accounts, sales invoices, cash/credit sales, and payment receipts.

states.loading: Skeleton list rows matching invoice structure
states.empty: Empty invoice ledger illustration with 'Buat Faktur Baru' CTA

screens.layout: Segmented control tabs (Semua, Belum Lunas, Lunas), search bar with filter chips, and list cards displaying invoice number, customer name, status pill, and Rp amount.

screens.name: Purchases (Pembelian)
screens.purpose: Track suppliers, purchase orders, incoming bills, and supplier payments.

states.empty: Empty purchase ledger illustration with 'Catat Pembelian' CTA

screens.layout: Supplier debt overview cards followed by scrollable purchase bills list with aging badges and approval status.

screens.name: Cash & Bank (Kas & Bank)
screens.purpose: Manage cash drawers, bank accounts, inter-account transfers, and operational disbursements.

states.empty: Empty account state with 'Tambah Akun Kas/Bank' CTA

screens.layout: Horizontal account summary cards (Kas Tunai, Rekening Desa BRI, etc.), quick action buttons (Transfer, Setor, Tarik), and chronological cash flow ledger.

screens.name: Accounting Core (Akuntansi)
screens.purpose: Manage Chart of Accounts (COA), manual & automatic journal entries, General Ledger, and Trial Balance.
screens.layout: Tabbed sub-navigation (Bagan Akun, Jurnal Umum, Buku Besar, Neraca Saldo) with expandable hierarchical ledger rows and floating quick entry button.

screens.name: Financial Reports (Laporan Keuangan)
screens.purpose: Generate Balance Sheet (Neraca), Income Statement (Laba Rugi), Cash Flow, and AR/AP Aging reports with CSV/Excel/PDF export.

states.empty: Select period to generate report state

screens.layout: Period picker header, report selector carousel (Laba Rugi, Posisi Keuangan, Arus Kas, Umur Piutang), structured financial statement tables, and sticky export action bar.

screens.name: Business Units & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage BUMKam multi-unit enterprise units (Unit Simpan Pinjam, Unit Air Bersih, Unit Pasar Desa), Cost Centers, Users & Roles (RBAC), and Audit Trail.
screens.layout: Grouped list sections for Unit Usaha, Manajemen Pengguna (RBAC), Periode Akuntansi, and Jejak Audit (Audit Trail).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Arunika as a professional-grade BUMKam financial management app in Bahasa Indonesia.
Follow the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality (Playfair Display for headings, DM Sans for body, warm paper-white surface #FAF8F5, forest green brand #3B5338, and ochre #8C6D46).
Ensure all data-dense tables and reports use tabular monospace formatting and clean hairline borders.
Implement fully working Indonesian forms for Sales, Purchases, Cash & Bank transfers, Journal Entries, and Financial Reports with CSV/Excel/PDF export simulation.
Ensure complete RBAC role switcher and multi-business-unit selector across screens.
